ov: الشمال الغربي (الإنجليزية: North by Northwest) هو فيلم تجسس تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة وصدر في 28 يوليو 1959. الفيلم من إخراج ألفريد هتشكوك وكتابة إرنست ليمان.
plotEn:
In the late 1950’s, a waiter pages George Kaplan at the Oak Room restaurant at the Plaza Hotel in New York City at the request of two well-dressed men. While summoning the same waiter, advertising executive Roger Thornhill is mistaken for Kaplan, kidnapped by the pair, and brought to the estate of Lester Townsend in Glen Cove. Townsend interrogates Thornhill and subsequently arranges to kill him in a staged drunk-driving crash; Thornhill survives, but fails to convince the police or his mother of what happened. Upon returning to the estate, Thornhill learns that Townsend is a United Nations diplomat.
Thornhill and his mother sneak into Kaplan's empty room at the Plaza, where the thugs have followed him. Thornhill heads to the United Nations General Assembly Building to meet Townsend, who turns out to be a different man. As he asks him about the man impersonating him, one of the gang's thugs throws a knife into Townsend's back. Thornhill is photographed grabbing at the knife, giving the appearance that he is the murderer. Thornhill flees, attempting to find the real Kaplan.
The "United States Intelligence Agency" (USIA) realizes that Thornhill has been mistaken for Kaplan, a non-existent agent they created as a decoy to distract their quarries, but its chief, "the Professor", decides against rescuing him for fear of compromising their operation.
